problems_fixed.what: Was a trivial mirror of silver[0] (same f=3x-1,g=x^2,input 2; fg vs gf scaffold each other). Replaced with different functions and input so it stands alone.
Was the exact numeric inverse of bronze[0] (f=4x-3, target 17 <-> f(5)=17); solvable by recall. Changed function and target.

opener_concept: A sweet machine that triples then adds 2: box 1 evaluates it forward (put in 4 -> 14 = f(4)), box 2 runs it backwards (out 20 -> in 6 = the inverse). The reveal names evaluate, invert and iterate as the whole lesson, all one machine.
notes: Audit issues fixed: bronze[1] degenerate sequence; silver[0] hint that gave the answer (now a process prompt: write y=2x+7, swap, rearrange); silver[1]/[2] duplicate pair; silver[4] recall duplicate; gold[3] hint that gave the inverse+equation (now a process prompt); and the platform-wide off-topic misconception problem (every problem carried all four misconceptions). Misconceptions were pruned to only the ones that genuinely fire for each problem type: function-evaluation -> inverse confusion; composites -> order; nth-term -> half-the-second-difference; iteration -> reuse-previous-answer; plus two real determinate errors added (square-a-negative on f(-3) -> -8; 6^2 read as 6x2 on the n^2+2n-1 term -> 23). Every null/off-topic misconception was removed. The two gold iteration answers the overnight audit flagged (x_2=1.516 and x_3=1.679) were already correct in the live and pre-fanout data and were re-verified by fresh solve, so they needed no repair. Added guided.opener, guided.teach (function evaluation / composites / iteration), guided_steps with completion boundaries on all 15 non-MC problems, tier_guides, per-problem hints, and trimmed method_card. Fixed em-dash labels in worked_examples (colon) since the validator scans them. Bank reordered so each tier's first problem is non-MC (function eval / composite / iteration) for the completion mechanic. Validator PASS; independent recompute of every box and expect clean. Only the practice_data column was patched.
